### Start development server

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/_blocks.mdx

Start the documentation website local development server.

```bash
pnpm www:dev
```

--------------------------------

### Run initial project setup

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/packages/shadcn/test/fixtures/frameworks/remix-indie-stack/README.md

Performs initial dependency and database setup tasks.

```sh
npm run setup
```

--------------------------------

### Install resources using shadcn add

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/registry/namespace.mdx

Install resources from a specific registry namespace, install multiple resources across registries, or install directly from a URL or local file path.

```bash
# Install from a specific registry
npx shadcn@latest add @v0/dashboard

# Install multiple resources
npx shadcn@latest add @acme/button @lib/utils @ai/prompt

# Install from URL directly
npx shadcn@latest add https://registry.example.com/button.json

# Install from local file
npx shadcn@latest add ./local-registry/button.json
```

--------------------------------

### Install from community registries

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/new.mdx

Download and install components from any community registry URL.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @[registry]/[name]
```

Fetch the URLs for documentation, examples, and API references for specified shadcn components. Run this command prior to creating, debugging, or using components.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest docs button dialog select
```

### Install dependencies manually and configure TooltipProvider

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/radix/tooltip.mdx

Install radix-ui manually and wrap the application's root layout with TooltipProvider.

```bash
npm install radix-ui
```

```tsx
import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        <TooltipProvider>{children}</TooltipProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

### Directory Structure for Multi-File Registry Item

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/registry/github.mdx

Example file structure for packaging multiple files such as configurations, documentation, and test setups into a registry item.

```txt
registry.json
config
└── vitest.config.ts
docs
└── testing.md
test
└── setup.ts
```

### Install Tooltip manually and configure TooltipProvider

```bash

```

```tsx
import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        <TooltipProvider>{children}</TooltipProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

### Quick configuration and installation with components.json

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/registry/namespace.mdx

Defines custom registries in components.json and installs a component from one of the configured namespaces.

```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@v0": "https://v0.dev/chat/b/{name}",
    "@acme": "https://registry.acme.com/resources/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @acme/button
```

--------------------------------

### Define registry item target alias in files.target

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/changelog/2026-05-package-imports-target-aliases.mdx

Specify target directory aliases in registry item file definitions to place installed files into the user's configured directories. For example, @ui/ai/prompt-input.tsx installs the component under the ui/ai directory.

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "registry/default/ai/prompt-input.tsx",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "target": "@ui/ai/prompt-input.tsx"
    }
  ]
}
```

```bash

### Reading messages with chat.get()

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/helpers/tanstack-ai.mdx

Use `get()` to return cloned TanStack `UIMessage[]` values from the start of the conversation without mutating the chat.

```ts
chat.get() // Every message.
chat.get(2) // The first two messages.
chat.get(0) // An empty initial conversation.
```

--------------------------------

### View shadcn init CLI options and arguments

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/cli.mdx

Lists the available flags and arguments for the init command, including template selection, component library base, presets, and monorepo configuration.

```bash
Usage: shadcn init [options] [components...]

initialize your project and install dependencies

Arguments:
  components                 names, url or local path to component

Options:
  -t, --template <template>  the template to use. (next, vite, start, react-router, laravel, astro)
  -b, --base <base>          the component library to use. (base, radix, aria)
  -p, --preset [name]        use a preset configuration
  -y, --yes                  skip confirmation prompt. (default: true)
  -d, --defaults             use default configuration: --template=next --preset=nova (default: false)
  -f, --force                force overwrite of existing configuration. (default: false)
  -c, --cwd <cwd>            the working directory. defaults to the current directory.
  -n, --name <name>          the name for the new project.
  -s, --silent               mute output. (default: false)
  --css-variables            use css variables for theming. (default: true)
  --no-css-variables         do not use css variables for theming.
  --monorepo                 scaffold a monorepo project.
  --no-monorepo              skip the monorepo prompt.
  --rtl                      enable RTL support.
  --no-rtl                   disable RTL support.
  --pointer                  enable pointer cursor for buttons.
  --no-pointer               disable pointer cursor for buttons.
  --reinstall                re-install existing UI components.
  --no-reinstall             do not re-install existing UI components.
  -h, --help                 display help for command
```

### Execute shadcn CLI Commands for Project Setup and Component Management

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/skills/shadcn/SKILL.md

Provides quick reference commands for creating projects, applying presets, inspecting preset state, searching registries, and previewing or adding components.

```bash
# Create a new project.
npx shadcn@latest init --name my-app --preset base-nova
npx shadcn@latest init --name my-app --preset a2r6bw --template vite

# Create a monorepo project.
npx shadcn@latest init --name my-app --preset base-nova --monorepo
npx shadcn@latest init --name my-app --preset base-nova --template next --monorepo

# Initialize existing project.
npx shadcn@latest init --preset base-nova
npx shadcn@latest init --defaults  # shortcut: --template=next --preset=nova (base style implied)

# Apply a preset to an existing project.
npx shadcn@latest apply a2r6bw
npx shadcn@latest apply a2r6bw --only theme
npx shadcn@latest apply a2r6bw --only font
npx shadcn@latest apply a2r6bw --only theme,font

# Inspect preset codes and project preset state.
npx shadcn@latest preset decode a2r6bw
npx shadcn@latest preset url a2r6bw
npx shadcn@latest preset open a2r6bw
npx shadcn@latest preset resolve
npx shadcn@latest preset resolve --json

# Add components.
npx shadcn@latest add button card dialog
npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/shimmer-button
npx shadcn@latest add owner/repo/item
npx shadcn@latest add --all

# Preview changes before adding/updating.
npx shadcn@latest add button --dry-run
npx shadcn@latest add button --diff button.tsx
npx shadcn@latest add @acme/form --view button.tsx
npx shadcn@latest add owner/repo/item --dry-run

# Search registries.
npx shadcn@latest search @shadcn -q "sidebar"
npx shadcn@latest search @tailark -q "stats"
npx shadcn@latest search owner/repo -q "login"
npx shadcn@latest search                          # all configured registries
npx shadcn@latest search @shadcn -q "menu" -t ui  # filter by item type

# Get component docs and example URLs.
npx shadcn@latest docs button dialog select

# View registry item details (for items not yet installed).
npx shadcn@latest view @shadcn/button
npx shadcn@latest view owner/repo/item
```

--------------------------------

### shadcn init [options] [components...]

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/cli.mdx

Initializes configuration and dependencies for an existing project, or creates a new project when provided a name. Installs required dependencies, adds the cn utility function, and configures CSS variables.

```APIDOC
## CLI Command: `shadcn init [options] [components...]`

### Description
Use the `init` command to initialize configuration and dependencies for an existing project, or create a new project with `--name`. The `init` command installs dependencies, adds the `cn` util, and configures CSS variables for the project. The `create` command is an alias for `init`.

### Syntax
```bash
shadcn init [options] [components...]
```

### Invocations
```bash
npx shadcn@latest init
npx shadcn@latest create
```

### Arguments
- **components** (string, optional) - names, url or local path to component

### Options
- **-t, --template <template>** - The template to use (next, vite, start, react-router, laravel, astro).
- **-b, --base <base>** - The component library to use (base, radix, aria).
- **-p, --preset [name]** - Use a preset configuration.
- **-y, --yes** - Skip confirmation prompt (default: true).
- **-d, --defaults** - Use default configuration: `--template=next --preset=nova` (default: false).
- **-f, --force** - Force overwrite of existing configuration (default: false).
- **-c, --cwd <cwd>** - The working directory. Defaults to the current directory.
- **-n, --name <name>** - The name for the new project.
- **-s, --silent** - Mute output (default: false).
- **--css-variables** - Use css variables for theming (default: true).
- **--no-css-variables** - Do not use css variables for theming.
- **--monorepo** - Scaffold a monorepo project.
- **--no-monorepo** - Skip the monorepo prompt.
- **--rtl** - Enable RTL support.
- **--no-rtl** - Disable RTL support.
- **--pointer** - Enable pointer cursor for buttons.
- **--no-pointer** - Disable pointer cursor for buttons.
- **--reinstall** - Re-install existing UI components.
- **--no-reinstall** - Do not re-install existing UI components.
- **-h, --help** - Display help for command.
```

### Install Carousel dependencies manually

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/aria/carousel.mdx

Install embla-carousel-react before copying the component source code manually.

```bash
npm install embla-carousel-react
```

--------------------------------

### Install Input via CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/aria/input.mdx

Add the Input component to your project using the shadcn CLI.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add input
```

--------------------------------

### Install project-conventions item from acme/toolkit

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/changelog/2026-06-github-registries.mdx

Installs the project-conventions item directly from the acme/toolkit GitHub repository.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add acme/toolkit/project-conventions
```

--------------------------------

### Manually install Toast dependency and configure RootLayout

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/base/toast.mdx

Install @base-ui/react and mount the Toaster component in app/layout.tsx.

```bash
npm install @base-ui/react
```

```tsx
import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/toast"

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        {children}
        <Toaster />
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

--------------------------------

### Initialize project with Remix Indie Stack template

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/packages/shadcn/test/fixtures/frameworks/remix-indie-stack/README.md

Run the create-remix CLI to scaffold a new application using the official remix-run/indie-stack template.

```sh
npx create-remix@latest --template remix-run/indie-stack
```

--------------------------------

### Fetch Component Documentation with shadcn CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/changelog/2026-04-component-composition.mdx

Pulls component composition, usage, and examples into context via the command line for developers and coding agents.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest docs card
```

### Install Kbd using CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/aria/kbd.mdx

Add the Kbd component to your project using the shadcn CLI tool.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add kbd
```

--------------------------------

### Initialize project configuration with shadcn init

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/packages/shadcn/README.md

Initializes dependencies for a project, adds the cn utility, and configures Tailwind CSS and CSS variables.

```bash
npx shadcn init
```

--------------------------------

### Install required dependencies

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/installation/manual.mdx

Install the necessary packages for styling, utility functions, and icons via npm.

```bash
npm install shadcn class-variance-authority cn lucide-react tw-animate-css
```

--------------------------------

### Initialize a new Vite monorepo project with CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/installation/vite.mdx

Scaffolds a new Vite monorepo project using the --monorepo flag with the shadcn init command.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest init -t vite --monorepo
```

--------------------------------

### Install and configure Sonner manually

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/aria/sonner.mdx

Install required dependencies and add the Toaster component inside app/layout.tsx.

```bash
npm install sonner next-themes
```

```tsx
import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/sonner"

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <head />
      <body>
        <Toaster />
        <main>{children}</main>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

--------------------------------

### Install Card component via CLI

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/components/aria/card.mdx

Install the Card component into your project using the shadcn CLI.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add card
```

### View initial repository directory structure

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/registry/github.mdx

Represents an existing repository layout before configuring it as a registry.

```txt
.
├── ...
├── .editorconfig
├── AGENTS.md
└── docs
    └── conventions.md
```

--------------------------------

### Install components from namespaced registries

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/changelog/2025-08-cli-3-mcp.mdx

Installs components from multiple configured namespaces using the @registry/name format.

```bash
npx shadcn add @acme/button @internal/auth-system
```
